target_customer: Data engineering teams that need to monitor the quality of data from raw events to delivered data products
problem: Data bugs reach downstream consumers before engineers notice; Lariat offered continuous data quality monitoring with user-defined metrics extracted, stored and visualised automatically.
business_model: B2B SaaS for data quality monitoring (pricing not found)

founders.name: Aaditya Talwai
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, about 10 years building DevOps and developer infrastructure products.

founders.name: Vikas Shanbhogue
founders.background_notes: Not on the YC page; named as founder and CEO by CB Insights and Employbl snippets, and addressed alongside Aaditya in the Product Hunt launch thread.

competitors.name: Monte Carlo
competitors.what: Data observability platform for data pipeline reliability

technical_complexity.rationale: Metric extraction over event streams and warehouses with agents and storage is standard data infrastructure with hard scaling parts, built by a Datadog alumnus.

defensibility.rationale: Metrics and monitors defined in the tool create some lock in, but data observability vendors with more funding offered overlapping features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying or buying Lariat; Monte Carlo raised $60M more in August 2021.

market_need_then: In 2021 data observability was an emerging category with a $25M round at Monte Carlo (February 2021) and $60M (August 2021), indicating enterprise interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses lariatdata.com, the name plus a descriptive suffix.
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch of an S3 data monitoring product; an open source lariat-agents repository on GitHub.

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search surfaced only profile pages and unrelated Lariat marks; no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Lariat Data was a three person Summer 2021 company led by a former Datadog architect selling data quality monitoring into a category where Monte Carlo had already raised tens of millions. The YC directory marks it inactive, one aggregator calls it acquired, and the website returned nothing, but no shutdown post or acquisition announcement was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: lariatdata.com returned an empty page. The pre-seed rests on a single database (Bouncewatch, $1.3M, 22 Sept 2021 with YC, 468 Capital, Hike Ventures); CB Insights instead lists a $130K seed on 3 Sept 2021, so the amount conflicts and one may be a data error. CB Insights search summary calls the company acquired, unverified. Vikas Shanbhogue is not on the YC page. Monte Carlo source came from a search result list, not an opened page. A TechTarget summary lists Bigeye, Acceldata and Datafold as rivals but is undated here so they are not recorded.
